ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus / Cobalt Kitty) Outlook Home Page persistence via WebView URL registry key
ucs.description: Hunts the signature OceanLotus persistence trick documented in Cybereason's Operation Cobalt Kitty: modifying HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\<ver>\Outlook\WebView\Inbox URL/Order/Method values so Outlook fetches and executes a remote HTML/JScript payload on every launch. APT32 has used this as their primary userland persistence since 2017 in lieu of Run-keys.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\*\\Outlook\\WebView\\*" AND Registry.registry_value_name IN ("URL","Order","Method") AND (Registry.registry_value_data="http*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="https*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="javascript*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="vbscript*") by Registry.dest Registry.user Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_value_name Registry.registry_value_data Registry.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | where count>0 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has @"\Software\Microsoft\Office\" and RegistryKey has @"\Outlook\WebView"
| where RegistryValueName in~ ("URL","Order","Method")
| where RegistryValueData has_any ("http://","https://","javascript:","vbscript:")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessParentFileName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImRegistryEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has @"\Software\Microsoft\Office\" and RegistryKey has @"\Outlook\WebView"
| where RegistryValue in~ ("URL","Order","Method")
| where RegistryValueData has_any ("http://","https://","javascript:","vbscript:")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, RegistryKey, RegistryValue,
          RegistryValueData, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: APT32 / OceanLotus Outlook Home Page Persistence (Cobalt Kitty)
id: 8c4f2c1a-3b7d-4f9e-9c6a-71d4e6b8a0c3
status: experimental
description: Detects modification of the Outlook WebView registry key (URL/Order/Method) to point at a remote HTML/script resource. Hallmark APT32 persistence documented in Cybereason Operation Cobalt Kitty.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1137/
  - https://www.cybereason.com/blog/operation-cobalt-kitty-apt
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026-06-12
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1137
  - attack.t1112
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: registry_set
detection:
  outlook_webview:
    TargetObject|contains|all:
      - '\Software\Microsoft\Office\'
      - '\Outlook\WebView\'
  value_names:
    TargetObject|endswith:
      - '\URL'
      - '\Order'
      - '\Method'
  remote_payload:
    Details|re|i: '^(https?://|javascript:|vbscript:)'
  condition: outlook_webview and value_names and remote_payload
falsepositives:
  - Legacy custom Outlook home page deployments (rare, should be allowlisted by URL)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\*\\Outlook\\WebView\\* OR *\\software\\microsoft\\office\\*\\outlook\\webview\\* OR *\\SOFTWARE\\MICROSOFT\\OFFICE\\*\\OUTLOOK\\WEBVIEW\\*) @TargetObject:(*\\URL OR *\\Order OR *\\Method OR *\\url OR *\\order OR *\\method) @Details:(http* OR https* OR javascript* OR vbscript*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate
| regex("(?i)\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\Outlook\\\\WebView\\\\", field=RegObjectName)
| RegValueName=/^(URL|Order|Method)$/i
| regex("(?i)^(https?:|javascript:|vbscript:)", field=RegStringValue)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, RegObjectName, RegValueName, RegStringValue, ContextImageFileName], function=count())
| sort(_count, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 DLL side-loading via trusted AV/vendor binary copied to user-writable directory
ucs.description: Catches OceanLotus's long-running side-loading kill-chain where macro/installer drops a legitimately-signed Symantec/McAfee/AVG/Kaspersky/Google host binary (RasTls.exe, mcoemcpy.exe, wsc_proxy.exe, GoogleUpdate.exe, klwtblfs.exe, sylog.exe, etc.) into %APPDATA%, %ProgramData% or %PUBLIC% alongside a trojanised companion DLL, then executes the signed host so the malicious DLL is loaded under a trusted process. This is the canonical APT32 stager pattern used by Denis/SOUNDBITE/KOMPROGO/Cobalt Strike loaders for ~8 years.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("rastls.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","mcods.exe","mcvsshld.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","goopdate.exe","googleupdate.exe","sylog.exe","mcutil.exe","hctxhmgr.exe","klwtblfs.exe","avgsvc.exe")) AND (Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["rastls.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","mcods.exe","mcvsshld.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","goopdate.exe","googleupdate.exe","sylog.exe","mcutil.exe","hctxhmgr.exe","klwtblfs.exe","avgsvc.exe"]);
let UserWritable = dynamic([@"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ (SideloadHosts)
| where FolderPath has_any (UserWritable)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | where FolderPath has_any (UserWritable)
    | summarize SideloadedDLLs = make_set(strcat(FileName,"|",SHA256), 10) by DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId
) on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          SignedHost=FileName, HostPath=FolderPath, HostSHA256=SHA256,
          ParentProcess=InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ProcessCommandLine, SideloadedDLLs
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["\\rastls.exe","\\mcoemcpy.exe","\\mcods.exe","\\mcvsshld.exe","\\wsc_proxy.exe","\\goopdate.exe","\\googleupdate.exe","\\sylog.exe","\\mcutil.exe","\\hctxhmgr.exe","\\klwtblfs.exe","\\avgsvc.exe"]);
let UserWritable = dynamic([@"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any (SideloadHosts)
| where NewProcessName has_any (UserWritable)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account=SubjectUserName,
          SignedHost=NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 / OceanLotus DLL Side-Load via Trusted Vendor Binary in User-Writable Path
id: f2a8d9c4-7b13-4e6f-9a05-c8e1b3d4f7a2
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of legitimately-signed AV/security-vendor host binaries (Symantec RasTls.exe, McAfee mcoemcpy.exe, AVG wsc_proxy.exe, Kaspersky klwtblfs.exe, Google goopdate.exe, etc.) from non-standard user-writable directories — the canonical APT32 DLL side-loading delivery chain dating back to Cobalt Kitty (2017) and observed through Canvas Cyclone / BISMUTH campaigns.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1574/002/
  - https://www.cybereason.com/blog/operation-cobalt-kitty-apt
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026-06-12
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  vendor_hosts:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rastls.exe'
      - '\mcoemcpy.exe'
      - '\mcods.exe'
      - '\mcvsshld.exe'
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\goopdate.exe'
      - '\googleupdate.exe'
      - '\sylog.exe'
      - '\mcutil.exe'
      - '\hctxhmgr.exe'
      - '\klwtblfs.exe'
      - '\avgsvc.exe'
  user_writable_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
  condition: vendor_hosts and user_writable_path
falsepositives:
  - None — these vendor binaries should only ever execute from Program Files / Program Files (x86)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\rastls.exe OR *\\RasTls.exe OR *\\RASTLS.EXE OR *\\mcoemcpy.exe OR *\\McOemCpy.exe OR *\\mcods.exe OR *\\McOds.exe OR *\\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\\WSC_proxy.exe OR *\\goopdate.exe OR *\\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\\sylog.exe OR *\\mcutil.exe OR *\\McUtil.exe OR *\\hctxhmgr.exe OR *\\klwtblfs.exe) @Image:(*\\AppData\\Roaming\\* OR *\\appdata\\roaming\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\appdata\\local\\temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\programdata\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\users\\public\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\windows\\temp\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(rastls|mcoemcpy|mcods|mcvsshld|wsc_proxy|goopdate|googleupdate|sylog|mcutil|hctxhmgr|klwtblfs|avgsvc)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)\\\\(AppData\\\\Roaming|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|ProgramData|Users\\\\Public|Windows\\\\Temp)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, SHA256HashData], function=count())
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: DLL side-loading via signed vendor hosts is APT32/OceanLotus's signature delivery primitive — MITRE G0050 explicitly maps the group to T1574.002, and FireEye/Mandiant, Cybereason, ESET (SOUNDBITE), and Volexity have all attributed RasTls.exe, McOemCpy.exe, wsc_proxy.exe and klwtblfs.exe sideloaders to this actor over multiple years (Cobalt Kitty 2017 → Canvas Cyclone/BISMUTH 2020+ → ongoing). Filt
